rows.text: Trick 1: Preservatives: sodium benzoate (jam/juice), sorbic acid, salt/sugar/s vinegar (traditional) — they inhibit microbes; quote two names.  ·  Trick 2: Sweeteners vs sucrose: aspartame (200×, unstable when cooked), saccharin (550×, safe for diabetics), sucralose (600×, heat-stable) — the stability note for aspartame is the exam trap.
